parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website service.
> The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: Template
parameters.description:
The defense mode for frequency control (HTTP flood mitigation). Valid values:
- **default**: Normal.
- **gf_under_attack**: Emergency.
- **gf_sos_verify**: Strict.
- **gf_sos_enhance**: Super Strict.
